svg.title: Prudently — Deployment & Connectivity Architecture
svg.desc: Every deployed component of the Prudently hospital-operations agent fleet on Google Cloud (us-central1): two Cloud Run services, eight Vertex AI Agent Engine Reasoning Engines, Firestore, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, Firebase Authentication, Gmail SMTP, Model Armor, and the CI/Terraform path that provisions and ships it all — with the one genuine network-hop Agent2Agent call called out explicitly.
svg.text: Every deployed component and every real connection between them. All Google Cloud resources live in us-central1.
mints & refreshes ID tokens, client SDK
Engines serve, not a network call
Supply Chain's agent object (running in-process, inside the watch loop above) makes one
genuine Agent2Agent call — a real outbound HTTPS request back to this same service's
own public URL, authenticated with the shared secret below, not an in-process shortcut.
Starlette sub-app (ADK to_a2a) running medrep_agent in-process,
X-A2A-Shared-Secret required, fail-closed if Secret Manager is unreachable
CORS allowlist · slowapi rate limiting (per-IP, endpoint-keyed)
OpenTelemetry ASGI instrumentation — every request traced end to end
VERTEX AI AGENT ENGINE — 8 deployed Reasoning Engines
each independently deployed + smoke-tested via stream_query
Live autonomous traffic runs in-process inside prudently-api (above), not by calling out
to these engines — each is independently verified live via stream_query instead.
one store per agent, scoped to
written every real change, read on recall
→ A2A hop → Model Armor → email send
in-process Runner and deployed engines alike
LOCAL / ONE-OFF TOOLING — human-triggered, not runtime
run against real Firestore/Firebase from a developer's own gcloud ADC —
never part of the deployed request path
Region lock: Cloud Run, Firestore, every Reasoning Engine, Memory Bank, KMS, and Model Armor all live in us-central1.

Real Google Cloud products deployed: Cloud Run · Vertex AI Agent Engine · Vertex AI Memory Bank · Model Armor · Cloud KMS · Secret Manager · Firestore · Cloud Trace · Cloud Logging · Firebase Authentication.
